claims: NASA's Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch no earlier than April 1, 2026.
Artemis II is the first crewed flight to the Moon in over 50 years.
Artemis II is a 10-day mission.
The Artemis II crew consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Reid Wiseman is the commander of Artemis II.
Victor Glover is the pilot of Artemis II.
Christina Koch is a mission specialist on Artemis II.
Jeremy Hansen (CSA) is a mission specialist on Artemis II.
Artemis II is a crewed flight test of the Orion capsule and Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis II tests life support systems.
Artemis II tests navigation.
Artemis II tests deep-space performance.
Artemis II follows a 10-day free-return trajectory around the Moon and back.
Artemis II will not land on the Moon.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to go beyond low Earth orbit since 1972.
Artemis II includes the first woman to fly in deep space.
Artemis II includes the first person of color to fly in deep space.
Artemis II faced several delays.
Artemis II's launch target shifted from 2024 to late 2025.
Artemis II's launch target shifted eventually to April 2026.
Artemis II delays were to resolve technical issues such as hydrogen leaks and life support testing.
Artemis III plans to land humans on the lunar surface
